svg.title: Locate Mindanao and the southwestern islands
svg.desc: Approximate modern locator of Mindanao, Jolo in Sulu and Simunul in Tawi-Tawi. The island chain lies southwest of Mindanao. Dots locate places, not historical boundaries, recorded voyages or the religion of all residents.
svg.text: Locate Mindanao and the southwestern islands

g.text: Places are references, not a map of every resident's religion.
Natural Earth, public domain | Small islands omitted; markers approximate | Not a boundary map.
